about: Vehicle roster, ordered weakest to strongest: classes run scouts -> highway -> heavy-duty -> offroad -> heavy, each class in a fixed order whose specs climb by a fixed step per car (CLASS_LADDER in src/game-config.js, applied by npm run rebalance: power per loaded tonne, tire grip and mud pull) and spread over unlock ranks 1 to 40 (the first few of each class are rank 1 free starters, the rest spread evenly over ranks 2 to 40), so a higher rank always means a stronger car and a higher price (the first paid car costs the class base, each later car one price step more); rank 1 cars are the free starters. Every kind of vehicle is welcome: some carry a load drawn into their art and counted in their mass (load), many carry nothing. There is no length cap: long rigs are framed by their own zoom and the in-game zoom button. Tires are fixed (wheelType, see wheel-types.json): to get something stronger, switch cars. Names and art briefs are original designs inspired by kinds of real vehicles (SnowRunner trucks, Forza Horizon off-roaders, rally cars and supercars), never a real make or model. status: playable (car.json and art exist), planned, needs-art.

classes.name: Scouts
classes.about: Light vehicles of every kind: classic and modern 4×4s, SUVs, pickups, buggies, UTVs, rally cars and supercars on off-road tyres. Some carry small loads, many carry nothing.

classes.name: Highway
classes.about: Road vehicles: vans, fast SUVs and grand tourers on all-terrain tyres, rigid trucks and semi tractors with their trailers. Quick and strong on firm roads, struggle off-road.

classes.name: Heavy Duty
classes.about: Work trucks for logging, construction, utilities, fire and rescue, plus heavy-duty pickups: strong, geared low, decent off-road.

classes.name: Off-road
classes.about: Cross-country trucks: army 6×6s and 8×8s, amphibians, swamp buggies, Arctic haulers and balloon-tyre crawlers built for mud, water, snow and rock.

classes.name: Heavy
classes.about: Huge prime movers, mobile cranes and mining giants: slow, enormous torque, oversize loads.
